bio.text: Stacy Garrity is the Pennsylvania State Treasurer, sworn into office on January 19, 2021, and elected to a second term in November 2024.
According to her campaign website, she is running for Governor of Pennsylvania in 2026.
She is a retired colonel in the U.S. Army Reserve who served in Operation Desert Storm, Operation Iraqi Freedom and Operation Enduring Freedom.
Before becoming Treasurer she worked as a cost accountant and later a vice president at Global Tungsten & Powders Corp. in Towanda.
According to her campaign website, she is a native of Bradford County and a graduate of Sayre High School and Bloomsburg University of Pennsylvania.
